package validators

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// Wire doubles use only unique subjects on the explicitly owned proof broker.
// They never subscribe to the real CSS provider subject.
func cssWireFixture(t *testing.T, reply func([]byte) []byte) *CSSValidator {
	t.Helper()
	serverURL := os.Getenv("T101_CSS_UNIT_NATS_URL")
	if serverURL == "" {
		t.Skip("set T101_CSS_UNIT_NATS_URL to the owned isolated proof broker")
	}
	conn, err := natsgo.Connect(serverURL, natsgo.Timeout(2*time.Second))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect isolated unit broker: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(conn.Close)
	subject := "t101.css.unit." + uuid.NewString()
	if reply != nil {
		_, err = conn.Subscribe(subject, func(msg *natsgo.Msg) {
			_ = msg.Respond(reply(msg.Data))
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("subscribe unit reply double: %v", err)
		}
		if err := conn.FlushTimeout(2 * time.Second); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("flush unit reply double: %v", err)
		}
	}
	return &CSSValidator{conn: conn, subject: subject}
}

func cssTestContext(t *testing.T) context.Context {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
	t.Cleanup(cancel)
	return ctx
}

func TestCSSValidatorSendsEveryStylesheetWithExistingContract(t *testing.T) {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	var requests []map[string]any
	v := cssWireFixture(t, func(data []byte) []byte {
		var request map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &request); err != nil {
			return []byte(`{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"bad.test.request","message":"invalid request"}]}`)
		}
		mu.Lock()
		requests = append(requests, request)
		mu.Unlock()
		return []byte(`{"isValid":true,"errors":[]}`)
	})
	files := []WorkspaceFile{
		{Path: "index.html", Content: "ignore non-stylesheet"},
		{Path: "styles/MAIN.CSS", Content: ".main { color: red; }"},
		{Path: "styles/layout.scss", Content: "$gap: 1rem; .layout { gap: $gap; }"},
		{Path: "styles/utility.acss", Content: ".utility { display: grid; }"},
		{Path: "styles/empty.css", Content: ""},
	}
	result, err := v.ValidateAll(cssTestContext(t), "task-css-contract", files)
	if err != nil || result == nil || !result.Valid || len(result.Errors) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("valid provider result: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
	}
	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	if len(requests) != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("provider requests=%d, want every stylesheet including empty existing file (4)", len(requests))
	}
	byPath := make(map[string]map[string]any)
	for _, request := range requests {
		meta, ok := request["meta"].(map[string]any)
		if !ok || meta["taskId"] != "task-css-contract" {
			t.Fatalf("missing exact task metadata: %#v", request)
		}
		path, ok := meta["path"].(string)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("missing source path: %#v", request)
		}
		byPath[path] = request
		rules, ok := request["rules"].(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("missing provider rules envelope: %#v", request)
		}
		list, ok := rules["rules"].([]any)
		if !ok || len(list) != 0 || request["locale"] != "en" {
			t.Fatalf("invented rubric or incompatible locale: %#v", request)
		}
	}
	wantLanguages := map[string]string{"styles/MAIN.CSS": "css", "styles/layout.scss": "scss", "styles/utility.acss": "acss", "styles/empty.css": "css"}
	for _, file := range files[1:] {
		request := byPath[file.Path]
		if request == nil || request["code"] != file.Content || request["language"] != wantLanguages[file.Path] {
			t.Fatalf("source/language mismatch for %s: %#v", file.Path, request)
		}
	}
}

func TestCSSValidatorMapsNegativeForEveryFile(t *testing.T) {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	count := 0
	v := cssWireFixture(t, func([]byte) []byte {
		mu.Lock()
		count++
		mu.Unlock()
		return []byte(`{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"selector.not_found","message":"Expected selector","position":{"line":3,"column":7}}]}`)
	})
	result, err := v.ValidateAll(cssTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "first.css", Content: "a{}"}, {Path: "second.scss", Content: "b{}"}})
	if err != nil || result == nil || result.Valid || len(result.Errors) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("all provider negatives must aggregate: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
	}
	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	if count != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("provider requests=%d, want both files", count)
	}
	for index, path := range []string{"first.css", "second.scss"} {
		got := result.Errors[index]
		if got.Code != "selector.not_found" || got.File != path || got.Line != 3 || got.Column != 7 {
			t.Fatalf("lost exact source/error mapping: %#v", got)
		}
	}
}

func TestCSSValidatorSemanticErrorsDoNotExposeProviderText(t *testing.T) {
	codes := []string{
		"selector.not_found", "selector.not_found_in_media", "declaration.not_found",
		"declaration.value_mismatch", "declaration.not_allowed_value", "occurrence.min",
		"occurrence.max", "media.not_found",
	}
	for _, code := range codes {
		t.Run(code, func(t *testing.T) {
			v := cssWireFixture(t, func([]byte) []byte {
				data, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"isValid": false, "errors": []any{map[string]any{
					"code": code, "message": "provider-private-source", "file": "provider-private-path",
					"position": map[string]int{"line": 3, "column": 7},
				}}})
				return data
			})
			result, err := v.ValidateAll(cssTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "styles/main.css", Content: "a{}"}})
			if err != nil || result == nil || result.Valid || len(result.Errors) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("known semantic code must remain negative: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
			}
			got := result.Errors[0]
			if got.Code != code || got.File != "styles/main.css" || got.Line != 3 || got.Column != 7 {
				t.Fatalf("lost safe code/source position: %#v", got)
			}
			if got.Message != "Stylesheet validation failed" {
				t.Fatalf("provider message exposed instead of static safe feedback: %#v", got)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCSSValidatorUnknownProviderCodeIsTechnical(t *testing.T) {
	v := cssWireFixture(t, func([]byte) []byte {
		return []byte(`{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"provider-private-source","message":"provider-private-message"}]}`)
	})
	result, err := v.ValidateAll(cssTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "style.css", Content: "a{}"}})
	if err == nil || result != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unknown provider code must be protocol error: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
	}
	if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "provider-private") {
		t.Fatalf("unknown provider code/text exposed in technical error: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestCSSValidatorRejectsMissingSource(t *testing.T) {
	v := cssWireFixture(t, nil)
	for _, files := range [][]WorkspaceFile{nil, {{Path: "index.html", Content: "<main/>"}}} {
		result, err := v.ValidateAll(cssTestContext(t), "task", files)
		if err != nil || result == nil || result.Valid || len(result.Errors) != 1 || result.Errors[0].Code != "NO_CSS_FILE" {
			t.Fatalf("missing stylesheet must be semantic negative: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestCSSValidatorUnsupportedSassPreflight(t *testing.T) {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	count := 0
	v := cssWireFixture(t, func([]byte) []byte {
		mu.Lock()
		count++
		mu.Unlock()
		return []byte(`{"isValid":true,"errors":[]}`)
	})
	result, err := v.ValidateAll(cssTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "first.css", Content: "a{}"}, {Path: "second.SASS", Content: "provider-private-source"}})
	if err == nil || result != nil || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "provider-private-source") {
		t.Fatalf("unsupported Sass must be generic technical error: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
	}
	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	if count != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unsupported source must be discovered before any provider request; requests=%d", count)
	}
}

func TestCSSValidatorRejectsMalformedProtocol(t *testing.T) {
	cases := map[string]string{
		"invalid JSON":            `provider-private-source`,
		"null object":             `null`,
		"missing validity":        `{"errors":[]}`,
		"null validity":           `{"isValid":null,"errors":[]}`,
		"nonboolean validity":     `{"isValid":"true","errors":[]}`,
		"missing errors":          `{"isValid":true}`,
		"null errors":             `{"isValid":true,"errors":null}`,
		"wrong errors shape":      `{"isValid":true,"errors":{}}`,
		"contradictory positive":  `{"isValid":true,"errors":[{"code":"invalid","message":"provider-private-source"}]}`,
		"negative without errors": `{"isValid":false,"errors":[]}`,
		"null error":              `{"isValid":false,"errors":[null]}`,
		"missing code":            `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"message":"provider-private-source"}]}`,
		"missing message":         `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"invalid"}]}`,
		"blank code":              `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"  ","message":"invalid"}]}`,
		"blank message":           `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"invalid","message":"  "}]}`,
		"wrong position":          `{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"invalid","message":"provider-private-source","position":{"line":"wrong"}}]}`,
		"trailing JSON":           `{"isValid":true,"errors":[]} {"private":"provider-private-source"}`,
	}
	for name, reply := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			v := cssWireFixture(t, func([]byte) []byte { return []byte(reply) })
			result, err := v.ValidateAll(cssTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "style.css", Content: "a{}"}})
			if err == nil || result != nil {
				t.Fatalf("malformed provider response must be technical: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
			}
			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "provider-private-source") {
				t.Fatalf("provider response exposed: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCSSValidatorCompilerErrorIsGenericTechnical(t *testing.T) {
	v := cssWireFixture(t, func([]byte) []byte {
		return []byte(`{"isValid":false,"errors":[{"code":"internal.compiler_error","message":"provider-private-source","received":"private-value"}]}`)
	})
	result, err := v.ValidateAll(cssTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "style.css", Content: "a{"}})
	if err == nil || result != nil {
		t.Fatalf("conflated compiler/environment error must not become learner failure: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
	}
	if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "provider-private-source") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "private-value") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "a{") {
		t.Fatalf("technical error exposed provider data/source: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestCSSValidatorTransportFailsClosed(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("no responders", func(t *testing.T) {
		v := cssWireFixture(t, nil)
		result, err := v.ValidateAll(cssTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "style.css", Content: "a{}"}})
		if err == nil || result != nil {
			t.Fatalf("no responders must not pass: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("cancelled context", func(t *testing.T) {
		v := cssWireFixture(t, nil)
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		cancel()
		result, err := v.ValidateAll(ctx, "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "style.css", Content: "a{}"}})
		if err == nil || result != nil {
			t.Fatalf("cancelled request must not pass: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("nil connection", func(t *testing.T) {
		result, err := (&CSSValidator{subject: "t101.css.unit.unused"}).ValidateAll(context.Background(), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "style.css", Content: "a{}"}})
		if err == nil || result != nil {
			t.Fatalf("nil connection must be technical: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("empty subject", func(t *testing.T) {
		v := cssWireFixture(t, nil)
		v.subject = " "
		result, err := v.ValidateAll(cssTestContext(t), "task", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "style.css", Content: "a{}"}})
		if err == nil || result != nil {
			t.Fatalf("empty subject must be technical: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
		}
	})
}
